title: 엽연초생산협동조합법시행령 / queue:ADDENDUM:35947:20251230:00010:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Organization of the Ministry of Economy and Finance) <Presidential Decree No. 35947, December 30, 2025>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 2, 2026: Provided, That amendments to Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but not yet effective shall take effect on the respective effective dates of those Presidential Decrees.
Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.
Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (48) Omitted.
(49) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Leaf Tobacco Production Cooperatives Act shall be amended as follows:
In the portion other than the subparagraphs of Article 6, Article 7 (1) and (2), and the portion other than the subparagraphs of Article 11, "Minister of Strategy and Finance" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Economy and Finance."
(50) through (313) Omitted.
